counterfactual_missing_items: Long-term follow-up for liver disease progression
Exclusion of other potential causes of liver enzyme elevation
decisive_items: Increased ALT (221 U/L), ALP (159 U/L), γ-GTP (66 U/L)
Elevated ALT (3094 U/L), AST (668 U/L), ALP (311 U/L), γ-GTP (52 U/L)
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including elevated liver enzymes and hepatomegaly, which are characteristic features of chronic hepatitis. R4 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, such as elevated Spec cPL and hyperechoic pancreatic surrounding fat, but it is not as comprehensive as R2.

rejected.why: Lack of comprehensive support from the vignette
Limited support from a single laboratory finding
Some supporting evidence, but not as comprehensive as R2 or R4
Append-only completion of R2, not a distinct diagnosis
